name: rest of season projected points added positive and net alongside the week variant
description: league_format_player_projection_values stores every period in one week column ('0', a numeric week, 'ros', 'ros_net'), and each period column pins its own sentinel. The table alias must therefore carry the period: without it these three columns hash to one alias, collapse into a single join group, and that join carries only the seeding column's week predicate -- so two of the three render the third's value under their own header. This fixture pins three distinct joins with three distinct period predicates, and pins that the two rest-of-season columns ignore the week param rather than following it. It fails at any revision where the alias omits the period. Params are explicit so nothing here is clock-derived.
